reproducibility: Each cell was captured twice. 49 of 108 repeat (identical, inside the playback bar only, or under 6 pixels); 59 do not (47 lesson cells: all of Weighing the Stars, Galilean Resonance and Moon image, 8 of Transit Lab, 3 of Kepler; 12 sandbox cells: 8 binary, 3 crowded, 1 close world). The staged-star lessons run a physics clock the capture cannot hold; a cell that did not repeat is compared by eye or by crop, never by hash alone.

failsByDesign.note: These fail by design: e2e/visualCriteria.criteria.js states the criteria and is run on demand (npm run e2e:criteria), not by the browser suite or CI. The passing ratchet on the same measurements is in e2e/canvasLegibility.spec.js; the prompt that makes a criterion pass moves its test into the suite. The label and selection-cue clauses of I-9 (17 + 5 cases at the 3.0 baseline) passed when the labels authority landed and moved to e2e/bodyLabels.spec.js, in the suite; the measured numbers under `criteria` stay as the 3.0 baseline.
